label: rem:soft-confinement-at-q0
title: Soft confinement level $\ell_*(q_0)$ from Plancherel decay
html:
Remark. Soft confinement level \ell_*(q_0) from Plancherel decay

1. Soft confinement at the substrate parameter. The Wedderburn block labels of H_n(q) are q-independent, but the Plancherel weights depend sensitively on q. At roots of unity, sharp truncation occurs. At the generic real substrate parameter q_0 \approx 1.11, no representation is strictly confined, but weights decay rapidly, producing a soft confinement level \ell_*(q_0) \approx 9.6. Partitions exceeding \ell_* contribute negligibly.

2. Implication for atomic braids. An atomic braid lives in H_{3A}(q_0). Soft confinement implies no truncation for light atoms, exponential suppression for medium atoms, and effective truncation for heavy atoms. This transition dictates why \alpha-cluster unfolding is numerically necessary beyond A \sim 4.

3. Numerical estimate. See Table. The rapid saturation demonstrates soft confinement. The cutoff \ell_*(q_0) \approx 10 is the horizon where grading effectively terminates.
